meta.name: hunt-saml
meta.description: Hunt SAML / SSO attacks. Patterns: XML Signature Wrapping (XSW) — modify Assertion while keeping Signature valid by relocating signed element, comment injection in NameID (admin@target.com<!--evil-->@attacker.com → some parsers see admin@target.com), signature stripping (remove Signature element entirely, server should reject but doesn't), key confusion (signed by attacker's IdP, accepted by SP), audience-restriction not validated, replay attack (same Assertion accepted twice within validity window). Tools: SAML Raider Burp extension, samlmagic, manual XML manipulation. Detection: any /saml endpoint, /Shibboleth.sso, /sso/saml/, Microsoft ADFS endpoints. Validate: account takeover via altered NameID, admin role injection via altered AttributeStatement. Use when hunting SSO flows, when SAML AssertionConsumerService is reachable, when chaining IdP-trust to SP-impersonation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你测试 SAML/SSO 系统的安全性，比如尝试修改断言中的用户名、绕过签名验证、注入 XML 实体等攻击手法。
howto.when: 当你发现 SAML 端点（如 /saml/acs、/Shibboleth.sso）或需要审计 SSO 流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个 SAML 响应是否存在签名剥离漏洞。
检查这个 SAML 断言能否通过 XML 签名包装绕过。
say.note: Claude 会演示如何插入恶意断言并保持签名有效。

say.text: 尝试在 NameID 中注入注释来绕过身份验证。
say.note: Claude 会解释注释注入的原理和测试方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you test SAML/SSO security by attempting attacks like modifying assertion usernames, bypassing signature verification, and injecting XML entities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you find SAML endpoints (e.g., /saml/acs, /Shibboleth.so) or need to audit SSO flows.

say_en.text: Help me test this SAML response for signature stripping vulnerability.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to remove the Signature element and modify NameID.

say_en.text: Check if this SAML assertion can be bypassed via XML Signature Wrapping.
Try comment injection in NameID to bypass authentication.
say_en.note: Claude will explain the principle and testing method of comment injection.
